Maxey's 27 leads a comeback from 17 down

Final · Thu, Nov 12 · Philadelphia

Philadelphia beat Toronto 123–112, a 11-point home win. The 76ers move to 10–3; the Raptors fall to 5–7.

1 · First half

How it started.

The Raptors led 33–24 after one quarter. At the half, tied 60–60.

2 · The difference

Maxey: 27 points and 8 assists

8 of 13 from the floor, 14 of them by halftime.

3 · How it turned

Down 17 in the first, tied 60–60 at the half, up 9 after three

Six 76ers scored 11 or more.

4 · Where it was won

Won the second and third quarters, 72–54

Second-quarter points 36–27; third-quarter points 36–27. Toronto had 7 turnovers in the third.

5 · Final

76ers 123, Raptors 112.

From the Raptors’ side: Lost the second quarter 27–36, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: the 76ers are 10–3, 2nd in the East, with 99% top-6 odds now. The Raptors are 5–7, 8th in the East, at 43%.

2 · The play of the game

Simons at the horn.

Anfernee Simons' 3-pointer at the first-quarter buzzer that cut Toronto's lead from 33-21 to 33-24 and capped an 8-0 Philadelphia run, the start of the comeback from 17 down.
